tips.title: Daily quests
tips.description: Check the Quest menu every day. Garden daily quests refresh each day and complete as you play.

tips.title: Fishing in a Square
tips.description: Tap START, then HIT! when the bite comes. Daily catches are capped, so pace yourself.

tips.title: Gather and craft
tips.description: Tap gathering spots in the Garden for materials, then craft items at the Atelier.

tips.title: Face Shop tickets
tips.description: Each Face Shop change uses one Face Shop ticket.

tips.title: Model House sets
tips.description: A Model House set bundles Interior Shop furniture into one purchase, priced below the items bought one by one.
